desc: Generate all primes up to 10^6 using sieve of Eratosthenes.
Compute all 400 numbers: for each pair of distinct primes (p,q) with p<q, compute p^(2a)·q^(2b) ≤ 10^12 (a,b ≥ 1), collect in list.
Sort the list, remove duplicates, store globally.
Read Q, then for each query A, binary search (bisect_right) the largest number ≤ A and print it.
Ensure fast I/O using sys.stdin.buffer and sys.stdout.
